relations.subject: Daya Ram Sahni
relations.evidence: Sahni graduated in Sanskrit from the Punjab University with a gold medal.

relations.evidence: In 1903, Sahni was posted to the Punjab and United Provinces circle where he worked under J. Ph. Vogel.
